Cathouse Blues.name: Cathouse Blues
Cathouse Blues.summary: In Cathouse Blues, you are a horny guy who has to memorize which 7 houses the ladies of ill repute wander into. Grab some cash from the teller, and visit each woman. A visit will cost $20, at which time you'll find yourself in her bed. Score with her as many times as you can before you're forced to leave for the next. The cops are in pursuit as well as a mugger who wants your money. Visiting a wrong house will cause you to be temporarily immobilized (a sitting duck for the cops) as you figure out what to do next. The roles of the men and women are switched in Gigolo.

Farmyard Fun.name: Farmyard Fun
Farmyard Fun.summary: Farmyard Fun is an Action game, published by Suntek, which was released in Europe in 1983.

Ikari Warriors.name: Ikari Warriors
Ikari Warriors.summary: Ikari Warriors for Atari 2600 port was released in 1990 by SNK as one of the final published games for the system.
